column1: # clues.tsv for ft_swap — hints only, never answers.

To exchange two values through pointers, both have to survive the exchange. Trace your code on 11 and 22, one line at a time: what does each of the two ints hold after each line, and is either value ever held nowhere?
What happens if both pointers point at the SAME variable? Trace your swap step by step for that case -- does the value survive, and is that what you printed?
